sens_en: to repair, to build, to study
origine_fr: Les traits d'ornement 彡 et 攸, qui donnait le son : orner. 攸, écrit 亻, 丨 et 攵, se lit yōu et ne donne plus le son xiū. Orner, mettre en ordre : réparer, construire, étudier.
origine_en: Decorative strokes 彡 and 攸, which once gave the sound: to adorn. 攸, written 亻, 丨 and 攵, is read yōu and no longer gives the sound xiū. Adorning, putting in order: to repair, to build, to study.
